text: Anika: Quick design review — small UX nits on Compliance > Encryption panel. TL;DR: label ordering, region filter behaviour, and audit-log copy are confusing on keyboard/screen-reader. Screenshots in the thread. Mike: Thanks! Can you paste the current copy + the order of badges? I want to see concrete examples before proposing changes. Anika: Sure — current visible line reads: ``` Encrypted • Region: us-east-1 • Managed key ``` There are two problems: (1) 'Encrypted' is visually a pill but not communicated to screen readers as state; (2) Region is buried in the middle and the Region picker defaults to 'All regions' which hides the selected region for users with long org lists. Liam: +1 on the a11y callout. For screen reader clarity I'd recommend a more explicit label and ARIA like: ``` Encryption status: Encrypted with customer-managed key ``` That keeps SR users aware of transient state changes when switching keys/regions. Sara: Also noticing keyboard focus order: tabbing lands on the 'Region' control after the audit link, which feels backward. I suggest ordering: [Encryption badge] -> [Region picker] -> [Audit log link]. That matches visual left-to-right and reduces cognitive load. Mike: For the audit log copy, ops folks want action-first phrasing. Current event: `kms.key_used` shows as "key_used" in the UI. Proposal: - Old: key_used - New: "KMS key accessed" with detail: "customer-managed key ID xxxxx was used by user@org.com for inference" This reads better in timelines and search results. Anika: Love it. Also small microcopy tweak for the badge: change "Managed key" to "Customer-managed key" (full phrase is clearer) and make it tabbable with role="button" + tabindex so keyboard users can open key details. ops-bot: deploy-preview:encryption-ux updated — https://deploy.preview.redwood/edge/enc-ux-1755 :eyes: Liam: Quick nit on contrast: the green pill text barely passes AA at 14px. Could we bump weight to 600 or add a subtle border? I can supply WCAG numbers. Sara: I'll make a small Figma update with new ordering and paste screenshots here shortly. Mike: OK let's pair on copy after the figma update. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Anika: Thanks — leaving this as an action item: Anika to update microcopy, Liam to add aria attributes, Sara to update layout and send new figma link.
